title: Keep the familiar entry points. Make the hierarchy clearer.
intro: The previous homepage already offered recommendations, categories and conversation starters. The opportunity was to organize those choices into a more coherent Web experience, with navigation that could support both discovery and ongoing chats.

items.label: BEFORE · SIGNED IN

figure.alt: Previous signed-in Talkie homepage with top navigation and rows of gold-framed character cards

items.title: A browsing page with many similar signals.
body: Repeated gold frames and dense card rows gave many elements similar visual emphasis. Site-level links occupied the top navigation.

items.label: REDESIGN · SIGNED IN

figure.alt: Redesigned signed-in Talkie homepage with persistent side navigation, character categories and conversation starters

items.title: A workspace for discovering and returning.
body: A persistent sidebar groups product destinations and recent chats. Clearer card hierarchy, quieter borders and larger imagery give character content more room.

Both versions use a dark interface. The design change is in hierarchy and structure: a consistent navigation system, clearer destinations, and a more restrained visual treatment around the character artwork.
